The upstream repository identifies this as a Nous brand asset. The repository
root publishes the MIT license, and no asset-specific exclusion was identified
at the pinned revision. Preserve its copyright and permission notice in copies
and presentation derivatives. The overview SVG contains that notice in metadata;
the PNG is distributed alongside this directory's license.

The exact upstream logo is used without redrawing it. Presentation derivatives
scale and place it beside Zentari text and an independent-project notice. This
does not claim trademark ownership, official product status, affiliation or
endorsement. It does not establish provenance for other Nous-themed portraits.
